title: bug: prompt-cache-launcher worker-type cases fail on bash: the cut parse_command_into_argv block now reads RUNTIME_PROTECTED, unbound in the test slice
description:
Repro (HEAD 6d88924a, and a clean git-archive HEAD snapshot): `node --test scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs scripts/tests/agent-runtime.test.mjs scripts/tests/resume-progress.test.mjs` → 43 pass, 5 fail, all `/bin/bash: <cmd> exports MOE_WORKER_TYPE=… over an inherited …` (prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs:446) with `type.sh: line 65: RUNTIME_PROTECTED: unbound variable`.
The test cuts moe-agent.sh between 'parse_command_into_argv() {' and '# Codex is interactive (TUI)' and runs it under set -u. That block now references RUNTIME_PROTECTED, which is set outside the slice (git log -S: 29de0da4, task-aa85ff13). Fix it in the test fixture or with a `${RUNTIME_PROTECTED:-}` default. Found by task-7f82e200 (CQ-V08b), which does not touch these lines.
definitionOfDone: `node --test scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs scripts/tests/agent-runtime.test.mjs scripts/tests/resume-progress.test.mjs` exits 0 on Linux bash
The PROTECTED-profile CLI resolution behaviour from task-aa85ff13 is unchanged (its own tests still pass)
